task_title: Floor 3 Slice 5: Companion combat-XP, leveling, evolution, abilities

plan_review.notes: Reviewer flagged: 1) ledger safety depending on clearEntityStores discipline - verified every removeEntity call site for a Health-bearing entity (damageSystem, healthSystem, deathTimerSystem, harvestSystem, lifetimeSystem, projectileCleanupSystem, returningProjectileSystem, trapSystem, bossChestPickupSystem) already calls clearEntityStores, and the 3 sites that do not (mob-abilities owned projectiles, itemPickupSystem gold/gem/item pickups) are entity kinds that never carry Health/Companion state, so they cannot poison the ledger. 2) Team.id vs Companion.ownerTeam as two sources of truth - verified components.ts documents ownerTeam as a mirror of the Team.id source of truth, so companionProgressionSystem correctly keys off Team.id. 3) empty per-target contributor maps after contributor cleanup - accepted as bounded/self-limiting since the outer entry is deleted once its target dies or is itself cleared. 4) KO/merit XP semantics - current behavior (contributors keep merit XP even if later KO'd) is intentional and consistent with the assist-floor design notes already in the PR. 5) multi-team full-pool-credit farmability - already flagged in the code/PR as a documented slice-5 simplification for revisit at slices 7/8. 6) species-token load-order stability - accepted for the current lab-only phase, follow-up needed before production spawn/persistence usage. Two alternatives considered (kill-receipt queue at applyDamage time; dropSystem-published dead-target list) were both judged worse on architecture/coupling grounds than the chosen standalone-system design.
